reference.title: Sample Motor Attributes
reference.shortdesc: This section shows three samples of motor attributes with varying health index values for reference.

section.p: This section shows three samples of motor attributes with varying health index values for reference. The motor attribute insights are fetched by the REST API and displayed on the web and mobile application.
The figures display the image and name of the motor attribute, the motor attribute’s health index value, the health, and the action required.
